description: Validate an email address: syntax, MX, disposable and role account. $0.01 USDC on Base per call. Returns a verdict of ok, risky or undeliverable without sending mail. Bad syntax returns 400, not charged. Don't use this for confirming a mailbox exists; no SMTP probe is made. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: mailsecuritytools_email_check
title: Mail Security Tools API: GET /v1/email-check
